culprit_citations.quoted_text: SC MidCo Oy term debt row reports principal EUR 83 while the flagged normalized principal_amount_usd is blank.
Greencross term debt row reports principal AUD 19,270 with USD cost/fair-value columns while principal_amount_usd is blank.
AX VI INV2 Holding AB term debt row reports principal EUR 10,735 with USD cost/fair-value columns while principal_amount_usd is blank.

findings.detail: Non-USD debt principal is captured only in source currency and principal_amount_usd is missing for FX01 rows.

rationale: FX01 is a real data error: raw SOI rows show non-USD debt principal/par amounts, but the row-validation artifact flags blank principal_amount_usd for the same CIK and period. The source does not show these as USD principal values; the normalized USD-principal field needs explicit FX conversion before USD par analytics.
